# Niels Erik Nandal

> AI systems engineer building ambitious products with deterministic backends, legible interfaces, and readable software. Open to full-time roles in AI and software engineering.

Canonical site: https://nielseriknandal.com/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://nielseriknandal.com/): Profile, featured work, and recent writing.
- [Projects](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects): Selected software engineering and AI work.
- [Writing](https://nielseriknandal.com/writing): Technical notes and build writeups.
- [CV](https://nielseriknandal.com/cv): Experience, education, projects, and technical skills.

## Selected projects

- [Nexus](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects/nexus): A production reading, notes, and AI workspace built around stable evidence, durable chat, and a shared resource graph.
- [niels-gpt](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects/niels-gpt): An end-to-end, laptop-first LLM pipeline from tokenizer training through KV-cache inference and chat.
- [Factory Simulator](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects/factory-simulator): Multi-agent LLM orchestration around a deterministic factory-scheduling simulation.
- [Suno Session Lab](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects/suno-demo): A navigable music-generation space using embeddings, clustering, and centroid-guided regeneration.
- [Fractal Chat](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects/fractal-chat): A grounded, chat-first reader for URLs, PDFs, and EPUBs.
- [Fractal Go](https://nielseriknandal.com/projects/fractal-go): A real-time multiplayer Go application with WebSocket synchronization and game-rule logic.

## Writing

- [Neural Networks from Zero: Embeddings and Backpropagation](https://nielseriknandal.com/writing/zero-to-hero-one): A plain-English walkthrough of learned embeddings, hidden layers, logits, cross-entropy, and backpropagation.
- [Xavier, Kaiming, and Batch Normalization Explained](https://nielseriknandal.com/writing/zero-to-hero-two): Why activation scale matters, when each initialization applies, and what batch normalization actually normalizes.
- [Building My First Real-Time Full-Stack App](https://nielseriknandal.com/writing/my-first-project): What a multiplayer Go app taught Niels about decomposing game logic, synchronizing state, and designing before styling.
